title.zh: P0 共同复核与纠错接力单元：制度可执行性证据包
title.en: P0 Civic Review and Correction Relay Cell: Institutional Execution Evidence Package

public_test.zh: 一条错误如果不能沿原渠道被纠正，这项AI服务就不能留在京张。
public_test.en: If an error cannot be corrected through every channel that carried it, the AI service must not remain in Jing-Zhang.

authority_boundary.zh: 本包把既有PILOT-A转成可交接、可验收、可停止、可恢复的制度运行样例。96平方米测试装配只是制度的最小物理载体；本包不是场地测绘、建筑方案、消防或无障碍合规结论、正式估算、采购批准或运营承诺。
authority_boundary.en: This package turns the existing PILOT-A into a handover-ready, testable, stoppable and recoverable institutional operating sample. The 96 sqm test fit is only its minimum physical carrier; this is not a site survey, building design, fire or accessibility compliance conclusion, formal estimate, procurement approval or operating commitment.

feasibility_layers.question_zh: 谁有权暂停、谁独立复核、谁把更正送回原渠道、谁允许结案？
feasibility_layers.question_en: Who may pause, who reviews independently, who returns the correction, and who may close the case?

feasibility_layers.question_zh: 独立复核瓶颈、必要角色、队列过载和角色缺失时如何保持失败闭锁？
feasibility_layers.question_en: How do review bottlenecks, minimum roles, overload and missing roles remain fail-closed?

feasibility_layers.question_zh: 无屏入口、私密复核、独立人员入口、受控存放和恢复为何必须形成空间分隔？
feasibility_layers.question_en: Why do screenless intake, private review, independent access, controlled custody and recovery require spatial separation?

institutional_state_machine.fail_closed_rule_zh: 角色、凭证、渠道签收或恢复证据任一缺失时，不得稍后补写并继续；案件保持HOLD或转入RETIRE。
institutional_state_machine.fail_closed_rule_en: A missing role, receipt, channel acknowledgement or recovery record cannot be deferred while the case advances; it remains on HOLD or moves to RETIRE.

states.forbidden_transition: INTAKE -> REVIEW before a complete channel inventory and pause decision
states.exit_condition: case ID, material status, impact class and every known channel are registered
every registered channel is paused or explicitly recorded as unreachable

states.entry_condition: pause receipt and bounded evidence bundle exist
states.forbidden_transition: REVIEW -> CORRECT when reviewer conflict is unresolved
states.exit_condition: basis, uncertainty, conflict check and conclusion or escalation are recorded
states.spatial_support: private independent review and separate reviewer access

states.entry_condition: review outcome requires correction or withdrawal
states.forbidden_transition: CORRECT -> CLOSED when any original channel lacks a front-end acknowledgement
states.exit_condition: old and new versions, correction time, owner and acknowledgement exist for every original channel
states.spatial_support: public correction table and revision-return wall

states.entry_condition: corrected case becomes a reproducible product or publishing-workflow failure
states.forbidden_transition: RETEST -> ADOPTION before the failed condition and retest result are recorded
states.exit_condition: failure fixture, trigger, repaired version and result are recorded without self-authorizing restoration
states.spatial_support: Zhongzhiyuan controlled retest and repair area

states.entry_condition: review and retest evidence are available to the service or procurement owner
states.forbidden_transition: ADOPTION -> CLOSED before recovery and original-channel closure
states.exit_condition: adopt, modify, restrict, pause renewal or retire is recorded by a human owner

states.entry_condition: adoption consequence identifies material, data, cache, backup, equipment and space duties
states.forbidden_transition: RECOVERY -> CLOSED with any unclosed recovery item
states.exit_condition: every required item is closed, isolated, retained under authority or restored with evidence
states.spatial_support: controlled records/recovery store and independent recovery exit

states.entry_condition: all seven receipts exist and every original channel, retest, adoption and recovery condition is complete
states.forbidden_transition: CLOSED is invalidated by any missing receipt, reopened channel or unresolved recovery item
states.exit_condition: case remains auditable; later evidence reopens it at PAUSE rather than silently rewriting history
states.spatial_support: public status board plus controlled case archive

envelope.derivation: A separate physical test-fit assumption maps the existing 12 by 8 adjacency pattern to metres for this P0 only; the source diagram remains non-metric.

zones.name_zh: 无屏入口与原渠道更正带
zones.name_en: Screenless entry and same-channel correction band

zones.name_zh: 独立复核人员入口与共同校译
zones.name_en: Independent reviewer access and civic translation

accessibility_working_envelope.required_check: authorized field survey, applicable-code review and co-testing with actual users before any physical release

flows.public: screenless entry -> intake -> explanation -> correction receipt -> exit
flows.controlled_evidence: records store -> independent review -> channel owner -> retest handover
flows.recovery: pause -> isolate material -> correct channels -> remove equipment and cached copies -> sign recovery

drawing_chain: 1:20 screenless counter, paper receipt and removable interface

operational_screening.admission_rule: When the active queue reaches eight people or demand exceeds the two-case-per-hour screening envelope, stop walk-in admission, keep urgent human explanation and the pause route available, and use appointments. Capacity must not increase by shortening independent review; reopening above the envelope requires additional independent-review capacity plus matching correction, retest and recovery capacity.
operational_screening.priority_rule: High-consequence reports retain human explanation and the ability to request a pause even when walk-in intake is closed; this does not guarantee immediate full review.

operating_scenarios.decision: adopt, modify or retire the protocol only; no live-service conclusion

operating_scenarios.condition: repeat bounded windows only after named roles, channel agreements and field baselines exist
size independent review, correction, retest and recovery as complete parallel lanes after observed demand; never scale by weakening review

independence_constraints: original_channel_owner must not serve as independent reviewer for the same case
material author or supplier must not serve as independent reviewer
service owner must not approve their own unresolved adverse conclusion
case steward must not close a case they accepted
evaluation lead may record a retest but must not restore service
data custodian may verify recovery evidence but must not replace the service owner's closure accountability

reference_90_day_schedule.formula: 4 hours x 3 windows x 13 weeks x 5 concurrent seats

staffing_screening.annual_fte_reason: Named operator, opening hours, productive-hour convention, leave, training and relief factors are not authorized.

procurement_cost_plan.monetary_update_rule: Add low/high CNY bands only after quantities, a dated authoritative or professionally cleared rate basis and owner review are recorded in sources; never label a participant band as a tender price.

maintenance_and_recovery.action: reconcile case IDs, two-channel inventory and paper receipts; reset synthetic material
test the no-phone route, channel reachability, expiry dates, printer and offline terminal
review conflicts, unresolved cases, accessibility barriers and pause decisions
complete missing-role, missing-channel, reviewer-outage and recovery-record failure injections
remove temporary equipment, close materials, caches and backups, restore the space and sign adopt/modify/retire

external_gates.required_evidence: named entity, site-use scope, dates and signatory authority
external_gates.enables: a fixed, time-bounded physical pilot at the named site
external_gates.blocks: fixed-site opening and any claim that a Civic Review Hall exists
external_gates.safe_state: staffed mobile counter plus separately bookable private room, or offline tabletop drill

external_gates.name_zh: 权属、现状、结构、消防与工程条件
external_gates.name_en: Ownership, existing condition, structure, fire and engineering
external_gates.required_evidence: authorized survey and competent professional review
external_gates.enables: measured fit-out decisions and competent professional release
external_gates.blocks: construction, fixed equipment and compliance claims
external_gates.safe_state: non-building paper and tabletop protocol rehearsal

external_gates.name_zh: 无障碍路线与共同测试
external_gates.required_evidence: measured route, applicable-code review and user co-test record
external_gates.enables: field use of the proposed arrival, review and exit route
external_gates.safe_state: screenless assisted rehearsal with documented unresolved access conditions

external_gates.name_zh: 材料来源、版权与用途授权
external_gates.name_en: Material provenance, copyright and purpose permission
external_gates.required_evidence: rights record, permitted purpose, expiry and withdrawal path
external_gates.enables: bounded use of cleared field material for the stated purpose
external_gates.blocks: ingestion, display or redistribution of real material
external_gates.safe_state: clearly marked synthetic evidence kit only

external_gates.name_zh: 隐私、数据期限与影响复核
external_gates.required_evidence: reviewed data protocol, minimization and residual-risk acceptance
external_gates.enables: purpose-limited custody of authorized case material
external_gates.blocks: personal-data intake, live interfaces and field KPI claims
external_gates.safe_state: paper case ID, no identity material and human custody of synthetic records

external_gates.name_zh: 原渠道责任与更正回送协议
external_gates.required_evidence: complete channel inventory, named owner and acknowledgement method
external_gates.blocks: live case opening, automatic correction and CLOSED status for a real case
external_gates.safe_state: human-signed correction ledger for controlled offline drill channels

external_gates.name_zh: 独立复核任命与利益冲突
external_gates.required_evidence: qualification, appointment, recusal and replacement procedure
external_gates.enables: field review and a review-conditioned service decision
external_gates.blocks: real-case review, adverse decision and restoration
external_gates.safe_state: synthetic role rehearsal with no field conclusion

external_gates.name_zh: 网络安全、离线切换与回滚
external_gates.required_evidence: bounded interface inventory, offline test, rollback and incident route
external_gates.enables: bounded channel interfaces with tested rollback
external_gates.blocks: network connection, live API use and automatic return
external_gates.safe_state: offline evidence package, paper receipts and manual per-channel acknowledgement

external_gates.required_evidence: appointed roster, sourced quantities and rates, funding and insurance basis
external_gates.enables: a declared operating window and resourced pilot
external_gates.blocks: fixed public hours, annual FTE, monetary estimate and service promise
external_gates.safe_state: single scheduled synthetic drill with participant reference shares only

external_gates.required_evidence: asset, material, cache, backup and space closure signed by required roles
external_gates.enables: deployment of reversible temporary equipment and final field closure
external_gates.blocks: equipment deployment and CLOSED status when recovery cannot be evidenced
external_gates.safe_state: no live deployment; use removable synthetic materials and record their reset

currently_judgeable: eight-state institutional machine has no permitted shortcut to CLOSED
seven receipt classes are present in one synthetic case dossier
six reference zones sum to the 96 sqm test-fit envelope
six procurement shares sum to 100 percent
all ten external gates remain HOLD and field release is false
all four safe branches map to explicit gates and preserve the public correction invariant
four missing-field injections produce 4/4 pause or retirement states
eight state-aligned RACI actions and nine unappointed role classes remain inspectable
A01 to A08 are participant-computable synthetic acceptance checks; A09 to A12 remain null
field_dependent: measured room, accessible route, engineering and fire conclusions
actual arrival, queue, service time and staff workload
actual quantities, rates, quotes, funding and operating cost
screenless parity, user understanding, appeals and correction time
real decommissioning and asset, data and space recovery
